title: Boey's Emerald Gear
description: Vanilla styled Emerald tools and armor.
body:
# Vanilla Styled Emerald Tools and Armor
This is my very first mod ever uploaded by me. I was deciding on whether or not I should upload this, however, I came to a conclusion I'd share it with the Minecraft community. Creating this project was really fun, and I want to continue adding frequent updates in the near future, as well as keeping updates recent.
## Heavily inspired by exline's Emerald Equipment mod!

<details>
<summary>What is Included in this Modification?</summary>

### 🤔 What is Featured:
- Emerald Tools: _Mine faster with tools that boast 250 durability, 14 efficiency, 
  and 6.5 attack damage._
- Emerald Armor: _Provides substantial protection with armor ratings of 2 (helmet), 
  4 (chestplate), 5 (leggings), and 3 (boots), alongside 0.5 rating toughness._
- Smelting & Blasting: _Burn down Emerald tools and Armor back into an Emerald as a refunding function_

### ⚙️ Specifications:
- Durability: _250 uses_
- Tool Efficiency: _14_
- Attack Damage: _6.5_
- Enchantability: _24_
- Armor Protection: _Helmet (2), Chestplate (4), Leggings (5), Boots (3)_
- Armor Enchantability: _9_
- Toughness: _0.5_

### 🍦 Enhanced Vanilla Gameplay:
- Balanced Performance: _Positioned between iron and diamond tiers, providing a 
  reliable choice for both efficiency and durability._
- Versatile Use: _Perfect for players seeking strong equipment without reaching 
  diamond rarity._
- Seamless Integration: _Crafting recipes (including reverse crafting), integrating smoothly with vanilla Minecraft mechanics._
</details>

<details>
<summary>Crafting Recipes</summary>
